title: Taking the Cloud Sky Sect
summary: As the ceremony ends, someone breaking through to Nascent Soul on the sect's spirit veins draws out every elder, and Wang Lin appears at early Nascent Soul. Sun Zhenwei turns on Li Muwan, and Wang Lin kills him, then tells the sect that Sun Zhenwei killed a disciple and forced Wan'er to marry while the elders looked away. The founding ancestors, including Chen Bailiang and Yun Tianzi, trap him in the Cloud Sky Great Formation, but Wang Lin's Ancient God restriction breaks it and the ancestors fall, and he calls down a Heavenly Tribulation to force the sect to hand over the soul blood of everyone above Foundation Establishment. Privately he tells Li Muwan he failed to form his own Nascent Soul and only condensed his clone into one, borrowing its power, and that he is not from Hou Fen but must return to the Country of Zhao for revenge. Li Muwan stays to lead the Cloud Sky Sect on behalf of her husband and to refine higher pills for him, holding the four surviving ancestors' soul blood for 500 years and winning them over with longevity pills. Wang Lin then leaves, vowing that Teng Huayuan will see him return.
events: A Nascent Soul breakthrough at the ceremony draws out the sect's elders
Wang Lin appears at early Nascent Soul; Sun Zhenwei turns on Li Muwan and Wang Lin kills him
Chen Bailiang and Yun Tianzi trap him in the Cloud Sky Great Formation
Wang Lin breaks it with an Ancient God restriction and defeats the ancestors
He makes the sect hand over its soul blood under threat of a Heavenly Tribulation
He tells Li Muwan the truth about his clone Nascent Soul and his past in Zhao
Li Muwan takes over the Cloud Sky Sect; Wang Lin heads for Zhao
cultivation: Wang Lin: early Nascent Soul, through his clone condensed into a Nascent Soul (his own failed). Chen Bailiang and Yun Tianzi: late Nascent Soul; the five ancestors are said to be at the peak of late Nascent Soul.
